name.fr-FR: Institutions liturgiques, tome I : Introduction et histoire jusqu’au XVIIe siècle
name.en-US: Liturgical Institutions, Volume I: Introduction and History to the 17th Century
name.pt-BR: Instituições litúrgicas, tomo I: Introdução e história até o século XVII

description.fr-FR: Premier volume de la seconde édition (1878) : brefs de Pie IX, préfaces, notions préliminaires sur la Liturgie et histoire de la Liturgie depuis les Apôtres jusqu’à la première moitié du XVIIe siècle (chapitres I-XVI), chaque chapitre clos par ses notes.
description.en-US: First volume of the second edition (1878): briefs of Pius IX, prefaces, preliminary notions on the Liturgy and the history of the Liturgy from the Apostles to the first half of the 17th century (chapters I-XVI), each chapter closed by its notes.
description.pt-BR: Primeiro volume da segunda edição (1878): breves de Pio IX, prefácios, noções preliminares sobre a Liturgia e história da Liturgia dos Apóstolos à primeira metade do século XVII (capítulos I-XVI), cada capítulo encerrado por suas notas.

fr-FR.editor: Société générale de librairie catholique, Victor Palmé (Paris)

sources.edition: Institutions liturgiques, 2nd ed., tome I, Paris, Société générale de librairie catholique, Palmé
sources.description: archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates used to drop running heads, marginal notes and page-foot notes from the body; page-foot notes became footnotes where their markers could be matched; the chapter notes stay as the closing section of each chapter). Raw OCR text in sources/french-originals.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; text first published in his lifetime (1840-1851) and reprinted by 1885.
